locator.section: 05-03 joint alexander eventius theodulus juvenal, Secret

entries.claim: The 05-03 joint alexander eventius theodulus juvenal Secret prints the 20-word proper body (w001–w020) and the abbreviated cue Per Dóminum. The full w021–w042 conclusion and Amen are supplied separately from this edition’s RG115a, not printed in full here. Neighbouring prayers, chants, headings and rubric prose are excluded; this is not calendar, assembly or actor approval.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a; ordinary conclusion addressed to the Father, including Amen

entries.claim: This separate rule supplies w021–w042: the ordinary 21-word conclusion and Amen. Each composite combines only loci of this same edition. Amen’s enumeration semicolon is literal; the selected separate response uses a period. This rule alone establishes no response actor or requirement to repeat each conclusion in an assembled commemoration group.
